text:
Product Overview
PM9028GTM V3 is our self-developed Managed High PoE Switch with 24*10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 ports, 4*10Gbps SFP+ fiber modules and a Console port to flexibly expand your network. Among them, ports 1-24 (support IEEE802.3bt, single port maximum output up to 90W) have PoE power supply function and support IEEE802.3af/at/bt standard. Can be used as a Power over Ethernet device that automatically detects and identifies compliant powered devices and supplies them with power over the network cable. Adopts store-and-forward technology, combined with dynamic memory allocation, to ensure that bandwidth is effectively allocated to each port. Support static routing function, provide complete security policy, perfect QoS policy and rich VLAN function, easy to manage and maintain, meet the networking and access requirements of enterprise, community, hotel, office network and campus network.
Product Features
Complies with IEEE802.3,IEEE802.3u,IEEE802.3ab,IEEE802.3z,IEEE802.3x,IEEE802.3af,IEEE802.3at,IEEE802.3bt   standards;
Support RJ45 (Auto-MDI/MDIX);
Panel light monitors working status and assists in fault analysis;
Supports full-duplex IEEE 802.3x flow control and Backpressure half-duplex flow control;
Support Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) function (IEEE802.3az);
10GE optical module required, SR/LR/LRM/ER/ZR models supported;
Three-layer routing protocol control, adapted to multiple services, efficient and secure information transmission;
The IP dynamic routing protocol supports RIPv1/v2, OSPFv2, and BGP4;
IPv4/IPv6 static routes are supported;
Support static convergence and dynamic convergence (LACP) 2 convergence modes, effectively increase the link bandwidth, improve the reliability of the link, and at the same time can achieve load balancing, link backup;
Management and maintenance Supports Console, Telnet, and SSH management modes;
The system supports WEB management, which facilitates installation and debugging for engineers and maintenance personnel;
Support PD-ALIVE function;
Supports file upload and download management through HTTP/TFTP/FTP.
